|----------|---------|
| **add_to_watchlist** | Add a stock symbol to your watchlist. |

| **place_order** | Place a buy or sell order. |
| **remove_stock_from_watchlist** | Remove a symbol from your watchlist. |

| **trading_logout** | Log out of the trading system. |
